answer.value: Pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data (public data mixture). Post-training included midtraining on 140B reasoning tokens followed by supervised fine-tuning and alignment via Anchored Preference Optimization (APO). Pretraining datasets are in a public collection; mid-training and post-training datasets will be uploaded later. The card does not state annotation, synthetic-data generation methods or how rights were obtained.
quotes: The model is a decoder-only transformer using GQA and NoPE (with 3:1 ratio), it was pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data.
Post-training included midtraining on 140B reasoning tokens followed by supervised fine-tuning and alignment via Anchored Preference Optimization (APO).
**Fully open model**: open weights + full training details including public data mixture and training configs

The datasets used for pretraining can be found in this [collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/HuggingFaceTB/smollm3-pretraining-datasets-685a7353fdc01aecde51b1d9) and those used in mid-training and post-training will be uploaded later
